{{Quote|I'm sorry, I should've told Nik the truth. I was just hoping to spare his feelings. Life with him was miserable. Not only were we barely scraping by, but I was fed up. His jealousy was driving me crazy! He didn't want me talking to anyone or going out. Life here is&hellip; better.|Ria Deleru, on her new life as a dancer|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Ria Deleru''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war, she immigrated to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the Republic, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], with her husband, [[Nik Deleru]], but the two found life in the planet's [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] difficult. They were among the thousands of other [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] who occupied the [[Old Galactic Market]] [[Sector/Legends#Planetary sectors|sector]] in the aftermath of the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] at the end of the war, and like many of their contemporaries, the two fell into severe poverty.

Around [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Ria became fed up with her [[Galactic economy|economic]] situation and Nik's jealous and obsessive behavior, and so chose to escape into a life as an erotic dancer with [[Hanera's Dance Troupe]]. She led Nik to believe that she had been captured by the violent crime organization known as the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]], and although he sent an emissary to retrieve her, she was able to convince the messenger that she had found a better life.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Nik and I left the homeworld together. His devotion was flattering&hellip; but I grew to realize the difference between love and obsession. Could you please tell Nik I was shipped off Coruscant? If he thinks I'm gone, he might move on.|Ria Deleru, to Nik's messenger|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Ria Deleru was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who lived during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resulting [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Ria was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to fellow Nautolan [[Nik Deleru]],<ref name="TOR" /> and at some point prior to [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="immigration">In conversation dialogue with Nik Deleru, it is revealed that their home was destroyed during the war. The codex entry for the [[Old Galactic Market]] reveals that the homes belonging to the alien squatters in the area were destroyed during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], which occurred in [[3653 BBY]], according to ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'' and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.</ref> the two left their species' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]] together. They ultimately settled on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]&mdash;a gleaming [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] that, despite housing the center of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] governance and finance, also played host to a huge population of impoverished [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] in its [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]]. It was there that the two Nautolans made their lives, much to Ria's chagrin.<ref name="TOR" />

In 3653 BBY, as Republic and Imperial delegates [[Alderaan peace conference|negotiated]] an end to the Great Galactic War on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] led their [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] in a massive invasion of the Republic's capital that came to be known as the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref> During the assault, Imperial [[Warship/Legends|warships]] dropped numerous bombs into the lower levels of Coruscant's [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], destroying Ria and Nik's home, along with thousands of others.<ref name="TOR" /><ref name="OGM">{{TORcite|type=codex|Old Galactic Market}}</ref> The Empire eventually left the world, but Coruscant remained in ruins and the Republic lacked the supplies to respond and rebuild quickly.<ref name="CIGC">{{TORcite|type=general|Crisis in Galactic City|Coruscant}}</ref> Eventually, Ria, Nik, and many other displaced families ended up settling in the [[Old Galactic Market]], a commerce [[Sector/Legends#Planetary sectors|sector]] which had been widely abandoned after the Sacking. In the decade that followed, the criminal syndicate known as the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] moved into the Old Galactic Market as well and began running a protection racket on the [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] in the area.<ref name="OGM" />

{{GameLSmechanics}}
During that [[Time/Legends|time]], Ria became fed up with Nik's behavior, which she saw as obsessive and overly protective. When Nik failed to make a protection payment to the guild, Ria saw it as an opportunity to escape her life and her husband. She fled their home and became an erotic dancer in [[Hanera's Dance Troupe]], an entertainment business based out of the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild headquarters]]. [[Hanera]] herself mentioned that she never saw someone with as much potential as Ria. Nik believed her disappearance meant that the Guild had kidnapped her in retribution for his late payment, and so sought help from [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Mal]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. Because Coruscant Security was overwhelmed with battling the Merchant's Guild on other fronts, its [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] were unable to help the Nautolan. Instead, Nik convinced a Republic war hero to help him find his wife. The war hero succeeded in catching up with Deleru in the Guild's headquarters, but the dancer was unwilling to return to her husband. She instead asked that the Republic combatant tell Nik that she had already been moved off-planet, in the hope that he would move on and leave her to her new life.<ref name="TOR" /> After the war hero returned to Nik with the false information, Ria sent the messenger an electronic message thanking the hero for complying and encouraging the being to return to see her.<ref name="Free and Clear!">{{TORcite|type=message|Free and Clear!|Ria Deleru}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I just wanted to thank you for your help with Nik. I'm sure he gave you quite the sob story, but we're really better off apart. I've got dreams and ambitions, you know?|Ria Deleru, in a message to the war hero|<ref name="Free and Clear!" />}}
[[File:Nik_Deleru.png|thumb|left|180px|Nik Deleru, Ria's husband]]
Deleru was a [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned Nautolan with large, black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] common to her species. Although her husband Nik loved her deeply, his appreciation for her bordered on obsession and jealousy,<ref name="TOR" /> and she felt that he prevented her from following her dreams.<ref name="Free and Clear!" /> After [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of living in poverty, Deleru decided she could no longer endure the emotional or [[Galactic economy|economic]] turmoil that had characterized her life. She found comfort among the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] dancers of Hanera's Dance Troupe, and decided to remain with them instead of returning to live with her distraught spouse. Despite her frustration with Nik, she did not want to upset him, and so instead of informing him that she had elected to leave, she allowed him to believe that she had been kidnapped. Upon the Republic war hero's agreement to uphold her deception, Ria asked that the individual return to see her dance under "less formal circumstances."<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ria Deleru was first introduced in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a massively-multiplayer online game produced by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] and released on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. Deleru is found on Coruscant, as part of the mission "For Better or Worse," available to any player characters aligned with the Republic&mdash;as such, the interaction with Deleru could be completed by any of the following class characters: [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]], [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]], [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|trooper]], or [[Voidhound|smuggler]]. Due to ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} nature as a role-playing game, the mission has two possible outcomes with regards to Deleru's fate. The player character can elect to maintain her deception of her husband, thereby allowing Deleru to continue pursuing her dreams. This decisions yields [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] alignment points. Conversely, the player can collect [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] alignment points by demanding that Ria return to Nik, or by agreeing to uphold Ria's lies only to then reveal the truth to Nik.<ref name="TOR" /> This article assumes that the Republic player character selects the light-side conversation choice; however, it should be noted that a [[canon]]ical storyline has yet to be confirmed.
